scope: A closed initial cohort of diagnosed, initially inactive adult HBV registry patients; repeated navigation supports monitoring and subsequently indicated care. Not a one-year gift, a treatment start, screening, or the infant program.
costPerspective: Present value of full recurring navigator, supervision and analyst capacity per initial registry person. No replacement patients or salary savings after attrition. Philanthropic navigation costs only; publicly financed tests, medication, surveillance and downstream health costs are excluded, not free resources. No current provider quote or restricted funding offer verified.
nullBoundary: No additional monitoring, no causal downstream effect, or complete replacement of existing funding yields no benefit. Harms can outweigh the modeled gain. Zero funded duration credits no benefit; no finite positive price is reported at null or harm.

assumptions.label: Annual navigator salary anchor
assumptions.basis: 2026 paper Table2: $65,000; not a NEMS marginal quote.

assumptions.label: Annual allocated clinical supervision
assumptions.basis: Paper Table2: $22,900; charged in full every funded year.

assumptions.label: First-year analyst support
assumptions.basis: Paper Table2 EHR analyst allocation $3,593.44; navigation text requires similar support. Transfer is an assumption.

assumptions.label: Later annual analyst support
assumptions.basis: Paper Table2 allocation $2,524.88; retained every later funded year.

assumptions.label: Initial closed registry cohort
assumptions.basis: Paper staffing range 2,000–3,000 per navigator. No replacement entrants or future salaries avoided after attrition are counted.

assumptions.label: Local fully loaded cost adjustment
assumptions.basis: 1 / 1.5 / 2 judgments for benefits, overhead and local costs, not observed inflation or quotes.

assumptions.label: Years of recurring support purchased
assumptions.basis: 35 / 20 / 10-year hypothetical commitments. Charge annual capacity throughout; not one year buying lifetime gains.

assumptions.label: Analyst health allocation window
assumptions.basis: 35 / 35 / 45 years, NOT the paper's horizon. Its total is lifetime; this approximates the timing of already discounted incremental health.

assumptions.label: Annual discount rate
assumptions.basis: 3% matches source. Discount costs annually; normalize discounted health weights to avoid double discounting the lifetime anchor.

assumptions.label: Health timing exponent
assumptions.basis: Weights year^shape: uniform, linearly later, quadratically later. No source annual trajectories available; a major judgment.

assumptions.label: Additional annual monitoring proportion
assumptions.basis: 28.35 / 10 / 3 percentage points over existing EHR, ReLink and usual care. Judgments, not observed effects. Assumes appropriate downstream care; testing itself is not QALYs.

assumptions.label: Source and downstream health transfer
assumptions.basis: 100 / 50 / 20% judgments for causal uncertainty and local age/severity/downstream-care mismatch. Not a validated correction for source inconsistencies.

assumptions.label: Health share caused by gift
assumptions.basis: 90 / 50 / 25% judgment; existing grants/reimbursement can make this zero. Full gift cost is still incurred.

assumptions.label: Net additional harm per initial person
assumptions.basis: Zero in central positive cases; signed downside tested separately. Includes unnecessary treatment, burden or disruption if attributable; not established zero harm.

sources.title: Starinieri et al.: Cost-Effectiveness of Interventions to Improve Retention in Care for Chronic Hepatitis B in the United States
